title: MedVL-SAM2: A unified 3D medical vision-language model for multimodal reasoning and prompt-driven segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2601.09879v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent progress in medical vision-language models (VLMs) has achieved strong performance on image-level text-centric tasks such as report generation and visual question answering (VQA). However, achieving fine-grained visual grounding and volumetric spatial reasoning in 3D medical VLMs remains challenging, particularly when aiming to unify these capabilities within a single, generalizable framework. To address this challenge, we proposed MedVL-SAM2, a unified 3D medical multimodal model that concurrently supports report generation, VQA, and multi-paradigm segmentation, including semantic, referring, and interactive segmentation. MedVL-SAM2 integrates image-level reasoning and pixel-level perception through a cohesive architecture tailored for 3D medical imaging, and incorporates a SAM2-based volumetric segmentation module to enable precise multi-granular spatial reasoning. translated_title: MedVL-SAM2：一种用于多模态推理与提示驱动分割的统一3D医学视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最新进展在报告生成和视觉问答（VQA）等图像级以文本为中心的任务上取得了强大的性能。然而，在3D医学VLM中实现细粒度的视觉定位和体积空间推理仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在力求将这些能力统一到一个单一且可泛化的框架中时。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了MedVL-SAM2，这是一个统一的3D医学多模态模型，可同时支持报告生成、VQA以及多范式分割（包括语义分割、指代分割和交互式分割）。MedVL-SAM2通过专为3D医学成像定制的内聚架构，将图像级推理与像素级感知整合在一起，并引入了基于SAM2的体积分割模块，以实现精确的多粒度空间推理。该模型通过多阶段流程进行训练……
tldr: 提出了MedVL-SAM2，一个统一的3D医学多模态模型，通过整合图像级推理与基于SAM2的体积分割模块，首次同时支持报告生成、视觉问答以及语义、指代和交互式多范式分割，实现了细粒度的多粒度空间推理。
en_tdlr: MedVL-SAM2 is a unified 3D medical vision-language model that integrates image-level reasoning with a SAM2-based volumetric segmentation module to simultaneously support report generation, VQA, and multi-paradigm segmentation (semantic, referring, and interactive).
